issue.message: Reading Resources using LocalContext.current.resources
issue.explanation: Changes to the Configuration object will not cause LocalContext.current.resources reads to be invalidated, so calls to APIs suchas Resources.getString() will not be updated when the Configuration changes. Instead, use LocalResources.current to retrieve the Resources - this will invalidate callers when the Configuration changes, to ensure that these calls reflect the latest values.

issue.message: For locale "fr" (French) the following quantity should also be defined: `many` (e.g. "1000000 de jours")
issue.explanation:
Different languages have different rules for grammatical agreement with quantity. In English, for example, the quantity 1 is a special case. We write "1 book", but for any other quantity we'd write "n books". This distinction between singular and plural is very common, but other languages make finer distinctions.
This lint check looks at each translation of a `<plural>` and makes sure that all the quantity strings considered by the given language are provided by this translation.
For example, an English translation must provide a string for `quantity="one"`. Similarly, a Czech translation must provide a string for `quantity="few"`.

issue.message: Formatting %d followed by words ("days"): This should probably be a plural rather than a string
